text: Most producers are sent back once because their first report does not account for every acceptance criterion: jobs 20261024-025358-kb23, -033758-c2h3, -045548-7qht, -055549-0qcy, -033935-c4w4 and -082859-skh5 each had a send-back, and the second producer run cost 9 to 17 minutes, often for a report that only restates what was already done. Find why the first report misses criteria (the producer prompt, the report schema, or how criteria are shown), make the first report list every criterion with its evidence, and measure the send-back rate before and after on the jobs' records.
